#### Liquid Flow Data Tab

The Liquid Flow Data Tab shows data for hydrocarbon liquid meters.

This tab is not available and is not displayed for Section-type locations.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 613;height: 264;" />

The following items are available on this tab:

- **Effective Date** - The date for which the data is applicable. This is dependent on Contract Day, Contract Hour and Resolution. For Hourly Resolution, the effective date will be the day and hour the data is effective for. For Daily Resolution, the effective date will be at the contract hour for the given day. For Monthly Resolution, the effective date will be at the contract day and hour for the given month.
- **Activity Codes** - These can be meter events, alarms, analysis changes or other items as selected on the <span class="Screen">Rollup Configuration Editor</span>. FLOWCAL calculates these at the hourly, daily, monthly, calendar and batch level. The user can choose which ones will appear by going to <span class="MenuItem">[System Rollup Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md)</span> and checking or unchecking options in the Activity Codes section.
- **Pressure** - Average meter Pressure for the meter. Average static Pressure for the location.
- **Temperature** - Average meter Temperature for the meter. Average Temperature for the location.
- **IV** - This is the total Indicated Volume for the period.
- **GSV** - This is the total Gross Standard Volume for the period, excluding PPAs. It includes CPAs.
- **Adj GSV** - This is the Adjusted Total Gross Standard Volume for the period. It includes PPAs and CPAs.
- **NSV** - This is the Total Net Standard Volume for the period, excluding PPAs. It includes CPAs.
- **Adj NSV** - This is the Total Net Standard Volume for the period. It includes PPAs and CPAs.
- **Mass** - This is the Total Mass for the Period, including PPAs.
- **S&W %** - Average Sediment and Water Percentage for the period.
- **SWV** - This is the Sediment and Water Volume for the period, excluding PPAs. It includes CPAs.
- **Adj. SWV** - This is the Sediment and Water Volume for the period. It includes PPAs and CPAs.
- **Eqv Gas Vol** - This is the Equivalent Gas Volume. This only appears for products that are Table E. It includes PPAs and CPAs.
- **Summed Comp Volume** - This is the Sum of Component Volumes, excluding PPAs. It includes CPAs.
- **Adj Summed Comp Volume** - This is the Adjusted Sum of Component Volumes. It includes PPAs and CPAs.
- **Eqv Energy** - This is the Equivalent Gas Energy. This only appears for products that are Table E. It includes PPAs and CPAs.
- **Completion** - Indicates whether all data is present for a record. When viewing data for a location, if any of the members is missing data for the time frame indicated by the effective date, the status will be marked as "Incomplete".
- **GMS Date** - This is the date that the data was written to the database.
